_comment: Australian CDR energy Product Reference Data endpoints. The fetch script appends /cds-au/v1/energy/plans to each baseUri. These retailers are hosted by the AER's Energy Made Easy (https://cdr.energymadeeasy.gov.au/<code>) and confirmed to return plan data. Endpoints that return nothing are skipped and logged. Some retailers (e.g. Red Energy, Alinta, Simply Energy, Aurora, OVO, Energy Locals, Sumo) publish from their own product base URI rather than Energy Made Easy — add those here once known. Authoritative list: https://www.aer.gov.au/energy-product-reference-data
